demoSeeds: K3 and K4 use public demonstration keys, never real ones; K1 and K2 use fresh random seeds, never written down

verdicts.claim: A sealed key holds no seed: for each of the 50 keys sealed at the default strength, no form of its seed (the raw bytes as text, hex, base64, base64url, or the PKCS#8 key in hex or base64) appears in the sealed file, and the file records 600,000 or more iterations.
verdicts.measured: 50 keys sealed at the default strength (50 record 600,000 or more iterations); seed forms looked for: 300, found: 0

verdicts.claim: Only the passphrase opens it: each of the 50 opens with its passphrase to a signer with the same public key as its seed; each of 3 wrong passphrases a key (150 tries) is refused; and on the 5 re-sealed keys, every one-byte change to the salt, the nonce or the sealed seed, the iteration count one up or one down, and a changed kind, is refused. None throws.
verdicts.measured: 50 of 50 opened with their passphrase to the same public key; 150 of 150 wrong passphrases refused; 5 of 5 re-sealed keys opened, then 395 of 395 one-byte, stretch and kind changes refused; threw: 0

verdicts.claim: A revoked key cannot sign: over organ 3's 1,000 bundles, with nothing revoked every one verifies; with the recorder's key revoked, every one is refused and the refusal names the revocation; likewise with the judge's key revoked; with the reviewer's key revoked, every bundle carrying a review is refused; and revoking a key that signed none of them changes nothing.
verdicts.measured: of 1000 bundles: 1000 verified with nothing revoked; refused as revoked: 1000 with the recorder’s key revoked, 1000 with the judge’s, 1000 of the 1000 carrying a review with the reviewer’s; 1000 verified with an unrelated key revoked

verdicts.claim: Rotation cuts off the old key: for 100 of the 1,000 jobs, after the recorder's key is rotated, a bundle signed with the new key verifies under the rotated trust list, and a bundle signed afresh with the old key, as a thief holding its seed would, is refused as revoked.
verdicts.measured: after rotating the recorder’s key, of 100 jobs: 100 signed with the new key verified; 100 signed afresh with the old key refused as revoked

verdicts.claim: The command line keeps no plain seed once a passphrase is given: acg keys with a passphrase writes no .seed file and no form of any seed anywhere under its folder; acg bundle with the right passphrase writes a bundle that verifies; with a wrong or missing passphrase it refuses, says why, and writes no bundle; and acg keys --seal turns plain seeds made earlier into sealed ones with the same public keys, leaving no plain seed behind.
verdicts.measured: with a passphrase: plain seed files 0, seed forms anywhere under the folder 0; the right passphrase signed a bundle that verifies: yes; a wrong one refused with no bundle: yes; none refused with no bundle: yes; --seal kept the public keys: yes, plain seeds left: 0
